title: Core Professional Skills Program
description: A mandatory onboarding program covering workplace communication, email writing, technical documentation, Microsoft 365, Git, prompt engineering, and API security basics.

modules.title: Module 1: Workplace Communication Basics
modules.description: Learn how to communicate clearly and professionally in the workplace.

assignment.instructions: Write a 5-line professional self-introduction including your name, role, current learning goal, one professional strength, and one area you want to improve.

questions.prompt: What is the main goal of professional communication?
questions.correctAnswer: To share information clearly and respectfully
questions.options:
To speak fast
To share information clearly and respectfully
To use difficult words
To avoid teamwork

questions.prompt: Professional communication should be clear, respectful, and purpose-driven.
Write one quality of good workplace communication.

modules.title: Module 2: Professional Email Writing
modules.description: Learn how to write clear, polite, and professional workplace emails.

assignment.instructions: Draft one professional email to a team member asking for a project update. Include a clear subject, greeting, message body, call to action, and closing.

questions.prompt: What should a professional email subject be?
questions.options:
Empty
Short and clear
Very long
Unrelated to the message

questions.prompt: A professional email should include a greeting and closing.
What is one important part of a professional email?

modules.title: Module 3: Technical Documentation Basics
modules.description: Learn how to write simple and useful technical documentation.

assignment.instructions: Write simple documentation for one software feature. Include feature name, purpose, steps to use, expected result, and common issues.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of technical documentation?
questions.correctAnswer: To explain how something works or how to use it
questions.options:
To confuse users
To explain how something works or how to use it
To replace the product
To make content longer

questions.prompt: Good documentation should be clear and organized.
Name one section commonly found in technical documentation.

modules.title: Module 4: Microsoft 365 and SharePoint Basics
modules.description: Learn the basics of Microsoft 365 tools used in office workflows.

assignment.instructions: Create one sample Word document, Excel tracker, or SharePoint folder and submit a screenshot or link.

questions.prompt: Which Microsoft 365 tool is commonly used for spreadsheets?
questions.options:
Word
Excel
PowerPoint
Teams

questions.prompt: SharePoint can be used to store and organize company files.
Name one Microsoft 365 application.

modules.title: Module 5: Git and GitHub Fundamentals
modules.description: Learn the basics of Git version control and GitHub collaboration.

lessons.title: Learn Git Full Course for Beginners

assignment.instructions: Create a sample GitHub repository, add a README file, make at least one commit, and submit the repository link.

questions.prompt: What is Git used for?
questions.options:
Video editing
Version control
Graphic design
Email writing

questions.prompt: GitHub can be used to host repositories online.
Which command is commonly used to save changes in Git?

modules.title: Module 6: Prompt Engineering for Productivity
modules.description: Learn how to use prompts for daily work, learning, documentation, coding, and communication.

assignment.instructions: Create 5 useful prompts for daily work: one for email writing, one for documentation, one for coding help, one for learning, and one for task planning.

questions.prompt: What makes a prompt more effective?
questions.options:
No context
Clear context and clear task
Random words
Very short unclear request

questions.prompt: A good prompt can include role, task, context, and output format.
Name one element of a good prompt.

modules.title: Module 7: API Security and OWASP Basics
modules.description: Learn basic API security risks and safe development practices.

assignment.instructions: List 10 common API security risks and explain each one in one line. Also mention one prevention method for each risk.

questions.prompt: What does OWASP focus on?
questions.options:
Graphic design
Application security risks
Video editing
Office decoration

questions.prompt: APIs should have proper authentication and authorization.
Name one common API security risk.

modules.title: Module 8: Final Assessment
modules.description: A comprehensive proctored exam testing knowledge across all modules.
